description: This PHP source file provides utility functions to generate font definition files for the TCPDF library, including reading map and AFM files, font metrics, encoding, and font file processing.
external_files: strip tags and inline includes such as gzcompress

methods.name: ReadMap
methods.description: Reads a character map file for font encoding.

methods.name: ReadAFM
methods.description: Reads an Adobe Font Metrics (AFM) file to extract font metrics and character widths.

methods.name: MakeFontDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a font descriptor array from font metrics and type.

methods.name: MakeWidthArray
methods.description: Builds an array of character widths for the font.

methods.name: MakeFontEncoding
methods.description: Builds encoding differences from a reference encoding.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.

methods.name: ReadShort
methods.description: Reads a 2-byte unsigned short from a binary file.

methods.name: ReadLong
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte unsigned long from a binary file.

methods.name: CheckTTF
methods.description: Checks if a TrueType font license allows embedding.

methods.name: MakeFont
methods.description: Generates a font definition PHP file for TCPDF from font files and metrics.
